title: macos_mail.open_message
description: Open a specific inbox message in macOS Mail.app via the message:// URL scheme (LaunchServices, not AppleScript — stays responsive when Mail's scripting interface is slow). `id` is the RFC Message-ID returned as the uid/id field of macos_mail.recent. Side-effect surface: brings Mail.app to the message and returns only a success signal.

id.description: RFC Message-ID of the message to open (the uid from macos_mail.recent, without angle brackets).
